name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: The browser's own select, drawn as the input: a #666666 hairline on Black that turns White on focus, the brand corner and a muted chevron. Phones open the system picker.
use_for: A pick of one from a short, plain list in a form or a filter row: a platform, a date range, a sort order.
never: A list that needs search or custom rows: use Select
Options that do something at once: use Dropdown Menu
A filled or gray field on Black
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no select in the brand assets): the input's hairline, fill and corner, the neutral steps for the chevron
